changelog: New FSA Gate 1 settings dialog in Backtesting (gear icon next to the toolbar toggle, or double-click the badge): Inputs (swing size x ATR 14, 0.5-10 in 0.5 steps; show swings/breaks/levels/badge), Style (bullish/bearish/unclear colours, label size), Visibility (which Viewing timeframes the overlay draws on -- the engine always runs on 4H regardless). Defaults/Cancel/OK, same as the reference TradingView indicator's own dialog.

Changing swing size rebuilds the indicator from the warm-up start (reset + replay, same path as a rewind) -- no lookahead, never patches an existing drawing. Every other setting (display toggles, colours, label size, visibility) only redraws -- the engine itself is untouched and keeps running.

Settings are saved per user (new user_indicator_settings table) and apply to every new session; changing them mid-session updates that same saved default, same convention as the existing drawing-tool defaults.

Every backtest order now also records gate1_atr_mult (the swing size the indicator was actually running at), carried through on a limit order's fill exactly like gate1_auto_state/gate1_agree already are. The Results page and Saved Backtests' gate-1 agreement breakdown are now grouped by gate1_atr_mult so a session with orders placed at more than one swing size never reports one combined number blending them.
release_notes: Two new migrations: 2026_10_10_0002 adds gate1_atr_mult (DECIMAL(4,2) NULL) to trades and backtest_pending_orders, same guarded-ALTER pattern as every migration since v3.20.3 -- existing rows stay NULL (they were all run at the old hardcoded 2.0, but this is NOT backfilled; the Results/Saved-Backtests breakdown groups a NULL-multiplier trade under its own 'legacy' bucket rather than assuming 2.0). 2026_10_10_0003 creates user_indicator_settings (user_id, indicator, settings_json, UNIQUE(user_id,indicator)) -- a new table rather than reusing user_drawing_defaults, since this payload's shape/validation (swing-size range, #RRGGBB colours, a visibility-by-timeframe map) is different from a drawing tool's settings object; see that migration's own doc comment. New Gate1SettingsController (get_gate1_settings/save_gate1_settings) validates every field strictly server-side and rejects anything unrecognised -- a saved default becomes every future session's starting point, so a partial/malformed save is refused outright rather than silently coerced. structure-gate1.js gained two new read-only snapshot fields (protectedLevelBar/bosLevelBar) so the overlay can draw Pine's own live 'protected level'/'BOS level' lines (FSA_Structure_Gate1.pine:205-206) -- bookkeeping only, no engine RULE changed; re-verified against the full parity/lookahead/tie-break suite after the change. gate1_parity.js's fixture reader now takes an optional atrMult field (defaults to 2.0 for every existing fixture) so a future non-default-swing-size export can be tested; no BTCUSDT_atr3.json fixture was supplied as of this release, so 3.0 parity is not yet verified against a real Pine export -- see the report for what IS verified (the mid-replay 2.0->3.0->2.0 harness test, which proves internal consistency, not agreement with the real indicator). New harness driver tools/ui-harness/drive-v3250.mjs covers: the dialog's 3 tabs, a display-only change never resetting the engine (proven via object-reference identity, not just visual inspection), per-timeframe visibility actually suppressing draw calls while the badge stays unaffected, settings surviving a full page reload (the client-side proxy for 'survives logout/login' -- a real login round trip needs Acrob's own browser), gate1_atr_mult recorded on a market order and carried through a limit order's fill, and the full 2.0->3.0->2.0 cycle matching independent fresh runs at each value byte-for-byte. Every pre-existing driver (drive.mjs through drive-v3240.mjs) passes unmodified. backtest_engine.php self-test: 104/104 (unaffected). php -l and node --check clean on every changed file; duplicate-name scan clean. Not yet verified from this environment (needs Acrob's own browser against live data, same standing limitation as v3.24.0/v3.24.1): the exact badge text at swing size 3.0 vs 2.0 on a real BTC 4H replay against the real TradingView indicator, and a real login/logout settings-persistence round trip.
